scope: current_trial_fields/current_issued_row_fields below describe the original internal schema. The frozen replay combines issued values and later oracle outcome diagnostics in one retained row. Outcome fields are never live admission inputs. External raw trials require the explicitly checked metadata shim described below.

external_schema.raw_trial_metadata: PDF/QMF raw trials may omit baseline/windows. Read-only analysis adds baseline from the same trial frozen arm and windows from the corresponding original trial, checking ceil(test_rows/32) and every explicit-service reconstruction. Raw logs remain unchanged.
external_schema.scalar_gate_weights: External gate weights=[1] represent one immutable external fused forecast, not physical-source influence.
external_schema.pdf_physical_source_weights: PDF request-level physical-source weights are in pdf_weights with active_sources; simplex is checked separately, and no internal .8 source cap is imposed.
external_schema.other_external_physical_weights: Use the method-specific README and actual logged energy/confidence coefficients. They must not be assumed to be simplex weights or subject to the internal cap.
external_schema.point_coverage: The external point gate does not use its adaptive q tracker. Its q-based coverage is a diagnostic, not executed calibrated protection.
external_schema.optimizer_placeholder: External closed-form-rule kkt=0 is an interface placeholder, not an optimization certificate.

current_trial_fields.seed: Imposed feedback-delay seed on a fixed input trace
current_trial_fields.results.MODE: Policy result with admissions, service gross, fees, net, drops and potential accuracy

current_issued_row_fields.k: Eligible lease origin window; joins the deterministic replay state
current_issued_row_fields.weights: Influence on current available forecast sources in replay source order
current_issued_row_fields.posterior_or_block_sd: Issued directional scale; a feature pending execution calibration
current_issued_row_fields.penalty: q_issued times scale for calibrated gates
current_issued_row_fields.gate_score: gain minus conservative cost 5, uncertainty penalty and margin
current_issued_row_fields.scale: Shared predictive tangent-trace scale used in weight optimization
current_issued_row_fields.solver_converged: False denotes the frozen solver's capped-prior fallback

current_later_outcome_fields.maturity: Earliest window at which all four lease-window labels are available
current_later_outcome_fields.truegross: Complete candidate-minus-reference gross contrast on common serving positions
current_later_outcome_fields.local_net: Actual cost-inclusive fixed-lease increment including extra interruption loss and fees
current_later_outcome_fields.standardized_score: (gain minus truegross)/issued scale; consumed by calibration only at maturity
current_later_outcome_fields.opportunity_slack: Wearable adapter diagnostic: local_net minus pessimistic_net_target, in [0,2]
current_later_outcome_fields.candidate_extra_correct: Wearable adapter diagnostic: correctly predicted positions lost to additional interruption

current_callback_fields.update_index: Boundary consuming the callback; must be >= maturity
current_callback_fields.standardized_score: Matured fork residual on that scale
current_callback_fields.q_before: Current calibration threshold before feedback update

live_application_state_required_but_reco: Globally unique origin/episode identifier and label deduplication identifiers
Source IDs and immutable issued forecast probabilities with availability mask
Current candidate/reference model version identifiers and restorable checkpoints
Joint block origin/maturity/mask and saved forecast evidence
Moment snapshot or an exactly reproducible archive/kernel state
Actual service interruption positions, admission/restoration events and fees
Deterministic pending callback queue and completed-label completeness state
live_boundary_guards: Empty forecast mask: retain reference before posterior access
Invalid shape/finite/PSD/mask inputs: explicit validation error; application retains reference and logs reason
Incomplete or overlapping lease: infeasible; no admission
Calibrator: use issued_q for violation, not current q; consume only mature callbacks
interpretation: Request-level verification checks recorded implementation behavior and identities. It is not a persistent queue, restart-recovery test, hardware benchmark, physical sensor-loss experiment or universal future coverage guarantee.
